items.title: A narco-sub washed up near their village. Inside was a troubling clue to its origins
items.description: At least seven narco subs have been discovered in Pacific waters in recent years, signalling a troubling new reality.

items.title: Live: Trump says US envoys waste too much time travelling, cancels Pakistan peace trip
items.description: The US president says there has been "too much time wasted on travelling" by his officials, repeating suggestions the Iranian leadership remains unsettled. Follow live.

items.title: Concerns community cohesion is 'going out the door' after Anzac booing
items.description: Jeers could be heard for more than a minute as Uncle Ray Minniecon spoke at yesterday's Anzac service in Sydney with similar scenes playing out in Melbourne and Perth.

items.title: Walter Mikac lost his wife and daughters at Port Arthur. Thirty years on, this is his message
items.description: On April 28, 1996, a gunman killed 35 people at Port Arthur. Walter Mikac's wife and two daughters were among them. Thirty years on, he says gun control is as important as ever.

items.title: Inside Chernobyl is a toxic world where frogs have turned black
items.description: Nuclear meltdown in 1986 reshaped ecosystems and human lives. Four decades on the legacy of the Chernobyl disaster is still unfolding.

items.title: 'Prince Harry is not speaking for the UK': The surprising comments made ahead of King Charles's US trip
items.description: Little more than a week after Meghan and Harry's "quasi royal" tour in Australia, King Charles will be conducting the real thing in America, with much higher stakes.

items.title: Thousands of Dutch families adopted the graves of people they never knew
items.description: In The Netherlands, a quiet commitment to honour the young soldiers who were buried thousands of kilometres from home has continued for 80 years.

items.title: Act before commodities boom leaves us bust, urges former Treasury boss
items.description: Former Treasury secretary Ken Henry says the under-taxed resources sector has hollowed out Australia's economy, and raising more revenue from the sale of LNG resources was in the national interest.

items.title: Social licence test shows why Labor acts on NDIS but not gas
items.description: Labor's radical transformation of the NDIS as it resists a growing chorus of support for a new gas tax exposes the limit of its willingness to act when given a social licence.

items.title: There's no autocorrect here. It's quiz time
items.description: Delighted by diagraphs or hyped for homophones? Step inside and showcase your spelling skills.

items.title: In the aftermath of complex grief there can be post-traumatic growth

items.title: 'Waiting for Armageddon': Nimbin preppers ready if world goes up in smoke
items.description: It may not be the end of the world, but these Australians are finding creative ways to beat the cost-of-living crisis and improve their food security in troubled times.

items.title: Two out of three stolen cars are left with 'some form of hazard' in them
items.description: 'Opportunistic' car thieves are leaving vehicles littered with syringes, weapons and even traps, and in 2025, 77 per cent of vehicles inspected by one contractor had signs of methylamphetamine used at levels harmful to health.

items.title: Police shoot at car amid chaotic night across Melbourne

items.title: At 85, Ringo Starr is still chasing his country music dream
items.description: Ringo's childhood love of classic country still influences the new music that The Beatles's drummer makes.

items.title: Shaun Micallef would hate to be immortal, so he wrote a vampire novel
items.description: After Shaun Micallef finished up 11 years hosting comedy news show Mad as Hell in 2022, the comedian did something unexpected: he wrote a 'gothic romance novel'.

items.title: You can holiday for free at this remote island, but there's a catch

items.title: Sex workers speak out about being caught in the middle of PNG's HIV crisis

items.title: Russian attack on Ukrainian apartment block kills seven, injures dozens
items.description: An apartment block in the south-eastern city of Dnipro was struck twice by Russian drones, officials say.

items.title: Housing developer Assemble slashes number of promised affordable homes
items.description: Victorian planning authorities will allow Assemble to significantly reduce the number of affordable homes offered at large developments in Melbourne's north by more than half.

items.title: Ancient and 'sterile' plant population found, but its location remains a secret
items.description: A second population of an ancient tree, King's lomatia, has been found in the south-west of Tasmania. A scientist says the precise location must be kept secret, or risk being 'killed by love'.

items.title: FOI documents show vetting process for NT's controversial Crown representative

items.title: Ollie Hollands 'in a good space' despite late omission after brother's struggles

items.title: Outback post office to stay open thanks to work of local women

items.title: Footballer returns to field after 15 days in induced coma
